matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: Adaptive Training Sample Selection automatically selects positive samples for each ground-truth object based on statistical characteristics of candidate boxes.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The proposed Adaptive Training Sample Selection (ATSS) automatically selects positive and negative samples based on statistical characteristics of objects.

matched_pairs.a_claim_text_normalized: The core distinction between detectors that rely on anchor boxes and those that do not lies in how positive and negative training samples are defined, not in the architecture itself.
matched_pairs.b_claim_text_normalized: The essential difference between anchor-based and anchor-free detection is how positive and negative training samples are defined.

unmatched_a.a_claim_text_normalized: Architectural choices alone do not explain the historical accuracy gap previously credited to anchor-free designs over anchor-based ones.
